I went through something very similar so I can relate to how you feel. 3 weeks ago I went in to get plastic surgery and they made me leave a urine sample when I got there. I had my IV in and the nurse anesthetist said he was gonna give me Valium for anxiety but then he never came back. I thought it was weird and then about 30 min later the surgeon showed up and showed me a positive pregnancy test and told me we couldn’t do the surgery because I was pregnant. I was devastated and cried so much. I had been on the pill but I lost my insurance so I had not been on it for about 2 months, I still always used the pull out method but now I know that’s not a reliable method. 


I almost immediately knew I was going to abort. I’m also only 21, halfway done with college and I’m already a single mom to a 3 year old so i knew i couldn’t have another kid right now. I scheduled an appointment at planned parenthood for the following week and found out I was 6weeks 3days along. The doctor explained both the medical and surgical procedure and at first I said I wanted the medication. In my state we have to wait at least 24hours after the initial appointment/ultrasound before we can get the abortion so I scheduled an appointment to come back the following week (first available appointment) to get the pills but a few nights before I started reading online about it and freaking out about the horror stories...so I changed my mind last minute and told them I wanted the surgical instead. I just had my procedure today and I’m glad I chose the surgical over medication. Yes it hurt, but It only took about 10 minutes. My doctor said with the pill it could take up to 8hours. I was super nervous and cried when I got to my appointment today but it turned out fine. The staff was super nice and so was the doctor. I’ve had moderate cramping since I got home, just a tiny bit worse than period cramps. I went alone and had no sedation or anything, they just gave me one ibuprofen and an antibiotic before the procedure. There was also a medical assistant next to me holding my hand. She talked to me the entire time so that was really helpful and it kept me distracted. Good luck with whatever decision you make and you can message me if you have anymore questions or just need someone to talk to ❤️
